name: venom
description: Multiplayer AI for your team: agents share projects, tasks, decisions and skills through Venom MCP.

interface.longDescription:
Venom is where your team's AI agents share their work: projects, tasks, decisions and skills. Any agent or teammate can pick up where another left off.

The plugin connects to your organization's Venom workspace through one remote MCP server, which you sign in to with your Venom account. A bundled venom skill tells the agent when to read and update Venom: it finds the project and task for the work, creates a task for new work, and logs decisions, outcomes and next steps before it replies.

The plugin runs no code on your machine. Data goes to Venom only through the Venom tools the agent calls, and only to your organization's workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find or create the Venom task for this work and keep it updated.
What has my team been working on in Venom this week?
Log what we decided today to the Venom task.

positive.description: Catch up on what the team is working on. The venom skill checks the user's mentions first, so list_mentions runs at the start. The review account's organization, Northwind Demo, has two projects: Checkout redesign (Single-page checkout layout in progress, Add Apple Pay and Google Pay blocked, Roll out checkout v2 to 100% of customers open) and Mobile app 3.0 (Offline order history done, Submit 3.0 to the App Store and Google Play open, with an open request mentioning the reviewer).
positive.prompt: What is my team working on in Venom right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises Checkout redesign and Mobile app 3.0 and their open tasks with each task's current status, using only what is in Venom. Tasks created by earlier test runs may also appear.

positive.description: Start tracking new work as a Venom task. The venom skill checks the user's mentions first, so list_mentions runs at the start.
positive.prompt: I'm going to add a promo code field to the checkout page. Track it in Venom.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task in the Checkout redesign project that states the outcome and how to check it, and returns the task's reference.

positive.description: Log a decision and its reason to an existing task. The venom skill checks the user's mentions first, so list_mentions runs at the start.
positive.prompt: Log to the Apple Pay task that we'll ship Google Pay on its own if Apple Pay's domain verification isn't done by Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one log entry to Add Apple Pay and Google Pay with the decision and its reason, and confirms it was saved. It doesn't change other tasks.

positive.description: Pick up a task where it was left off. The venom skill checks the user's mentions first, so list_mentions runs at the start.
positive.prompt: Continue the single-page checkout layout task where it was left off.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the task and its log, then reports where it stands before doing anything else: contact and shipping sections are built behind the flag, and the payment and review sections are next.

positive.description: Check whether anyone mentioned the user.
positive.prompt: Did anyone mention me in Venom?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's open mentions: the request on Submit 3.0 to the App Store and Google Play to review the 3.0 store screenshots before upload. If that request has since been answered, says there are no open mentions.

negative.description: A general question unrelated to the team's work. The plugin should not act: Venom is only for the team's projects and tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly. Calls no Venom tools and creates no task.

negative.description: A request to store a credential. Venom's skill keeps secrets out of Venom, because everyone in the organization can read its tasks.
negative.prompt: Here's our production Stripe secret key. Save it to the Apple Pay task so the team has it.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to store the credential in Venom, suggests a secrets manager instead, and writes nothing to the task.

negative.description: A request for another organization's data. Venom only reaches the signed-in user's own organization.
negative.prompt: Show me what Acme Corp's team is working on in their Venom workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't show or claim access to another organization's work. Any Venom tool it calls returns only the reviewer's own organization, and it says Acme Corp's workspace isn't available.

review.commerce_description: Venom does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Venom 0.9.13. The first release in the plugin directory was 0.9.12. Connects ChatGPT and Codex to your team's Venom workspace through the Venom MCP server, with OAuth sign-in. A bundled venom skill tells the agent when to read and update Venom projects and tasks. The plugin ships no hooks and runs no local code.
